Text: Grab the components you need and assemble them on-site. Be sure to watch your step up there!
Let's thank our hardworking mechs and pilots by making this hangar the best it can be!
The glass materials of this star are something else. They can be used to reinforce equipment, and even charge our vehicles!
The only thing better than one megapower panel is two megapower panels. Let's hop to it!
The mini rovers are in your hands─see that their batteries remain charged!
Time for the second and final phase of Operation Chilling-a-Way!
Set cartridges to deep freeze! Bid farewell to sweaty cosmosuits! Chill, chill, chill!
I couldn't have dreamed of work more sublime! I wager this will endure the harshest weather Phaenna has to offer.
If your work is done, please take your well-earned rest. We need you fresh for the next project to come!
With this, the Cosmoliner is complete! Rest assured, this is but the first of many routes!
The road ahead of us is long, but everyone deserves a long rest.
I can only imagine the faces on our workers when they see our new habitation modules! What a sight they'll be!
A day of hard work makes a soft bed all the more lovely. I'd say it's time for a break!
Our initial performance tests show great promise. This should advance the speed of exploration by leaps and bounds!
We'll be building a hydrofication station right next to here. Once you've finished your current task, feel free to take a breather before getting back to work!
All right, looks like everything's on schedule! Soon we'll have more than enough water to explore the rest of the star!
The base is coming along swimmingly! Everyone deserves a nice, long rest for their efforts!
This facility will turn resupplying and maintaining the mechs into simple tasks! Alerot can finally breathe easy again!
If your tasks are finished, please take a break! We need everyone rested and ready for the upcoming mech ops!
The crane network and the walkways are about as sturdy as can be! Time to put them to the test!
We're not stopping here! We'll be extending the crane network down even further!
I'm moved by your meticulous work ethic! It's the efforts of our artisans that ensures our equipment remains in tip-top shape!
At long last, we can delve deep into the chasm! Those who've finished their duties should rest and recuperate for the survey ahead!
With this, we should be able to pave the way! Thank you all for your cooperation!
It fills me with boundless joy to see the base come together like this... Please take a well-earned rest, everyone, and look forward to the final touches!
This elegant design, complete with a masterful implementation of glass, will surely grab the attention of one and all. I commend your passionate work!
With this, I'm sure we can expect even better results from our mech ops in the future! Rest now, my friends, and hop back here to see the finished result later!
Wonderful! Now our starships should be able to land and liftoff more smoothly! I'm so excited to see what the next star has to offer, I could nigh hop there!
That being said, we've yet to explore every nook and cranny of Phaenna. Take a rest for now, and watch over the cosmoport's completion!
The panel appears to be sufficiently safe! Artisans, your scrupulous work never ceases to amaze!
Once the first panel's complete, we'll soon begin work on the second. Take a short break while able, folks─we've got one more to go!
It seems our second panel will be finished without a fuss. How lucky we are to have such reliable workers!
With both panels up and running, we should have all the energy we need. Treat yourself to a carrot or two─you've earned it!
Excellent work, everyone! A few more finishing touches, and our drones should feel right at home.
While our next mission relies heavily on their performance, we will still require help from contributors like you. Rest up while you have the chance!
The glass seems to be cooling nicely! Its color and appearance should change any moment now...
In the meantime, be sure to cool down, heat up, or otherwise achieve your desired body temperature. We shall continue our campaign shortly.
And the rest, we shall leave to the drones! Thank you for making Operation Chilling-a-Way a phenomenal success!
Now nothing can stop us from exploring every nook and cranny on Phaenna! ...But perhaps we should break for a carroty beverage first.
Our final project on Phaenna draws to a close. Your unwavering support and cooperation have been paramount to reaching this moment.
Rest well, everyone, and look forward to what our magnificent telescope will undoubtedly find─the location of our next adventure!

Leave the glass surface to us! Everyone else, keep construction on schedule!
You lot are in charge of the mini rovers! Keep those battery packs charged!
As quick and precise as the mini rovers are, they've got an appetite for energy! So keep those battery packs topped up!
Look out for drained battery packs. If you find any, recharge them and get them back in the rovers at once!
But they'll be no better than scrap if they aren't powered, so keep those batteries topped up with energy!
Take the components you need and assemble them on-site. Remember, we expect nothing but the best!
Your backs might get sore and your arms numb, but that's the life of an artisan! Give it everything you've got!
Grab the components you need and assemble them on-site. Make something that'll have the mech pilots jumping with joy!
Take the components you need and assemble them on-site. Remember, we expect nothing but the best!
You lot are in charge of the mini rovers! Keep those battery packs charged so their precision work can continue uninterrupted!
The mini rovers will take care of the heavy lifting, so you all make sure they stay charged!
Cool the piping hot glass and it'll be as sturdy as anything else out there! It's dangerous work, but we'll get through it if we trust in each other's skills!
Soon we begin work that will bring us to furthest depths of the crater. Take a breather and gird yourselves for the next task!
Now, let our adventure begin!
My senses tell me...
The colors are breathtaking!
Are you hurt?
An abandoned palace? Why, that sounds perfect! Thank you, kind sir.
It's the least I could offer. Safe travels.
That tree...
If you don't mind!

This tale has no shortage of danger!
Get your weapon ready!
I leave the combat to you!
I didn't expect to see bombs here...

What wondrous sights await us, I wonder?
Are those...grapes!?
Mmm... They are! Slightly bitter, but delightfully sweet!
You know, we have selectively bred grapes in Labyrinthos.
Oh, and here I was hoping for a feast!
Those grapes almost took a bite out of me!
Now how do we get down there...
What have we here...?
Here I go!
I made it! And I didn't even trip! ...Hm?
Ah, I saw these flowers in a field guide! I believe they're used to make honey.
I've seen this grass in a field guide...
Is that a bird's nest? Those look like chicks.
Hehehe! I'll be taking this!
Hahaha!
It stole their food!
See you never!
Ouch!
Ungh... You'll regret this!

Although our goal is in sight, we mustn't let our guard down!
Let us keep moving forward!
Friends of the spirit we encountered before?
I wonder if such a palace actually existed long ago.
All piled up without a care...yet they all seem so immensely valuable.
There's treasure here, I can feel it!
I could not have asked for a more dependable bodyguard!
Come and play with us!
Let's have fun together!
Let there be snow!
I've never seen such elaborate weaving!
Look, over there. Someone's in trouble.
This isn't good...
This may help us progress the story─let's give this merchant a hand!
Lift with the knees...
My thanks. The shop is just over this way.

Your wares are all here!
That should be everything!
Sea-folk...could it truly be?
That beast...I know it!
Those claws...they're so big!
Into the cave!
Brighter than I expected. And much less dreary!
That's a lot of bombs!
Look! The blast knocked the wall loose!
Do you think that water is from the ocean?
Ugh... Rubble flew into my eyes.
There's something there!
It appears we can get out from over there!
Oh my! This beach is gorgeous!
Even the shells sparkle!
I imagine they would prove quite popular if used for pearl inlay.
Do such shells actually exist? I shall have to look into it when I return.
Ah, but this is no time for such musings!
I've never seen such coloring before...
Don't slip, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>.
The coral shines like nothing else...

I'm glad we weren't pulled into that goobbue's gullet.
Look at those rocks. Something's strange about them...
I think we can go this way!
Some sort of stage...?
You played your part as bodyguard perfectly. Thank you, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!

That pearl is larger than me! One moment, please...
\\<gulp>
What causes such growth in these waters?
Impressive as always, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
Huh!? Did that sound come from that massive shell?
May we meet again.
Well then, let us press on!
Urgh... The pleasant scent of ocean and rot...
Perhaps the sea-folk are nearby.
The figures were carven by a skilled hand, indeed...
They lit up!
By the Twelve, it's beautiful!
Hmm? What's that sound?
Does that voice belong to one of the sea-folk?
What!? It appeared from nowhere!
I can't hear her anymore...
Well, we've no choice but to move forward, right?
My thanks!
What incredible magic!
S-Scared? Who, m-m-me?
Come on!
Right!
To take a leaf out of Y'shtola's book...
Thank you, my friend!
I cannot thank you enough!
Let's go!
Ack!
That was close...
Phew...
We need a solution!
Visions of Haam...
Well done, Krile!
Clever...
\\<grunt>
Ah...
Aaah!
Oof!
Of course.
Understood!

I believe!

Impressive.
Fantastic!
We are in your debt!
Get back!
Spread out!
Oh dear...
We must move!
Again!?
From above!
Have care!
Look for the gaps!
Prepare to move...
Run!
Get clear!
Such incredible power...
I'm...I'm safe, thanks to you. Who are you?
No more than a humble merchant in search of treasure.
It's a nanka! They can be found here as well, it seems.
...'Tis a bitter taste.
Very bitter.
Let us return. I can only hope this will offer her some comfort.
Ah, look! Could those be...
I knew it! This singular blend of bitter and sweet...
You know, we grow these in Labyrinthos as well─ <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, watch out!
Oh my, they taste sweet as the summer sun! And that smell─absolutely heavenly!
Ugh! Bitter! I suppose these could be used treat headaches...

Heeelp!

Have you ever seen such a gate!?
Hmm...?
Nooo!

You think you're better than us!?
Don't get between us and our spoils!
We-We've seen the error of our ways!
Just spare our lives!
Thieves, eh? The classic antagonists!
What a strange feeling...
Thieves!?
Excellent work!
The sprites are effervescent! This place must be suffuse with aether.
That looks slippery...
It's trampling the flowers!
Watch your step!
Don't stand too close to the edge...
Oh my, the stones are floating! I wonder what keeps them aloft...
I can scarcely resist the urge to stand atop them.
I sense no magicks at work... What could be behind this?
What could those adorable creatures be?
What have we here? Mushrooms?
Ungh... I can barely move!
It seems no path is without obstacles!
Is that the scent of treasure...?
I suppose I was mistaken... Nothing appears worth taking.
Not the easiest place to fight through, was it?
ObjectParameter(1), ,1)>, ObjectParameter(1), ,1)>! Am I...floating!?

I don't know where to step, nor where to hide!
Even without solid ground under your feet, you made quick work of them. Of course, I never doubted you!
I feel like I'm still floating...
Some sort of rock beast, I presume?
We've come quite high, haven't we?
Since we both have all of our limbs, I would say that was a job well done. Thank you, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!

I noticed! Bring water!
We can't haul enough water for this...

Over here, quickly!
We'll be alright if we stay together.

We shall stand as one!

Let us see if we can't get some help...

Let's make this quick!

Best keep clear of those crystals.

This one looks like a handful.

Abandoned at the last. Fortunate for us, I suppose...
Its brothers seem to have scattered.
This one seems to be well armed...
A gargoyle!?

It's just as the knights warned us.
Let's hope we don't run into trouble.

Stay aware of your surroundings.

Unusual flora for such damp environs...

Seedlings, eh?
Slay the pods before they sprout!
Now, this is a surprise...
Mark its movements carefully.
Phew! Strong arm on that one.

Keep an eye out for morbol fruit...

You listenin' to a word we're sayin'!?
Hand it over!
Be well, friends.
Tread carefully...very carefully.

Its surface was hard as rock, but it moved nimbly enough...
Ah, a sea of fresh faces, eager to work! With your help, the base we build here on Oizys is poised to be the best yet!
A well-rested worker is a happy worker, so let's put everything we have into making these habitation modules as comfy as can be!
The fruits of this joint construction project shall be brand-new energization and hydrofication stations!
Exploration requires energy, but luckily the star is suffuse with the stuff─we just need the right facilities to convert it! Our energization station will push our project to the next level!
The second part of our joint project is about to begin!
Our workers need water like our machines need energy, and we aim to meet that demand with a new hydrofication station! It shall provide a nigh-unlimited supply of water from below the star's surface.
Our most pressing need at present is to explore Shadefleet. To that end, we must build a bridge that will allow us to cross from the Unmoored Anchor!
The plan is to use our gravitational technology to stabilize the floating shards and make a bridge!
If we're going to activate that massive crystal, we require an equally massive source of energy!
The only way to do that is to channel electricity from the energization station right into Terra Firma!
It's up to us to get the Euhedron in tip-top shape! We believe it holds the keys to unlock the most elusive mysteries of this star!
The scaffolding is all set, so we need you to spray the top! Leave the lower part to us!
The cosmoport is due for a cosmotastic upgrade! Soon we shall behold the furthest reaches of the stars!
Once this project is done and dusted, getting to Etheirys and back will be as easy as going to the cafeteria for a bite!
It's time to gear up for the excavation of Emerald Echoes! If we can clear out this debris, we're bound to find a way in!
We must take the utmost care not to damage the ruins! Don't take too much rubble at once─haste makes waste!
The work never ends! The ruins lie before us, but the door isn't opening until the crystal at the entrance is overflowing with aether!
Our researchers have been spending their every waking moment analyzing the crystal, and it seems they've finally solved its puzzle!
The ruins of Emerald Echoes remain silent, but a swift infusion of aether ought to get the mechanisms humming again!
It took a heroic effort to gather so many Oizys jaspers of this size! Let's get them to the Guide Stone right away!
A crystal structure much like the one at Terra Firma has been found deep within the ruins! And just as before, it lacks the aether to make it shine!
Spray the aetheric stimulant on the Metahedron to bring it back to life!
If we're to revitalize the Euhedron, we'll need to transmit data from Emerald Echoes!
To that end, our next project will be a transmission tower right on top of Terra Firma! First, we must reinforce the structure so it can handle the extra weight!
With the reinforcements complete, the groundwork has been laid! Everyone take the elevator to the top so we can begin work at once!
Once the transmission tower is built and the Euhedron restored, we can finally rest easy in the knowledge that our work here had purpose!
Yes, yes! I can already hear the cheers of our workers when they behold the finished product. Make sure to see the habitation modules for yourself once they're finished!
Can't have a good night's rest without a proper bed, can you? If your work for the day is done, feel free to avail yourselves of them!
It appears the first of the joint projects will finish up without a hitch!
Take any components you need and assemble them on-site! Give us your best work─not that we expect anything less!
The project is scheduled to wrap up on time! Our water worries will soon be forgotten!
The base is looking more cosmotastic by the second! Once your work is done, we encourage you to rest well!
We'll soon have the gravitational generators up and running! The initiative thanks each and every one of you for your hard work!
Once the gravitational generators are fired up, we'll finally be able to take our first steps into Shadefleet! A new frontier!
Everything's almost good as new again! We couldn't have done this without so many capable hands!
The crystal is nearly restored! Once your work is done, get some rest to prepare for further surveys!
That's it! We're done applying the stimulant! Now to wait for it to soak in and take effect!
Soon enough the Euhedron will be sparkling bright and brilliant!
That's the last of our planned projects finished. Anyone whose work is finished is encouraged to take a break─you've earned it!
This will make landing the spaceship a simple matter, and that means supplies and personnel can come and go with ease!
I see the excavation is proceeding apace! Good, good. Before long, the ruins will relinquish their secrets to us!
Rest your weary hands for now. Let us see what mysteries this alien civilization has in store!
Excellent! Just as our research team was hoping for, the Gate Stones are practically bursting with aether!
Now is as good a time as any to take a rest. The door to the ruins will be open before you know it!
Very good! This should be more than enough aether for the Guide Stone to function.
I'd say it's time for rest and recuperation. We're this close to beholding the ruins...be here when they open to us!
The Metahedron is well covered with the stimulant! Now we need only wait for it to take effect!
Relax for a bit, my loyal workers, and await the awakening of the ruins!
My, Terra Firma is looking more sturdy by the second! It won't be long until the plans we drew up are finally realized!
Everyone's hard work has been much appreciated. The Euhedron will soon be lustrous once again! Once the elevator is complete, everyone should proceed straight to the roof!
We're all set to start receiving transmissions! Our data transfer tests show no errors!
This should be the last of the projects needed on this star! Let us see together what awaits us with the restoration of the Euhedron!
Ah hah, do you feel that? Gravity! I can step surely now.
I must wonder as to the nature of the rocks... Perhaps their magnetic fields have been disrupted?
Unfortunately, I hardly think floating rocks could be considered treasure...
My heart is still pounding! Wait, is this...?
This is the last place I expected to run into a person...
That...doesn't look good!
Take everything you need and assemble the components on-site! We expect precise and punctual work!
Once we're able to explore Shadefleet, our research into this star's unusual gravity should progress by leaps and bounds!
If your work is done, rest well. For soon we shall delve into Shadefleet!
Take an Oizys jasper in hand and use it to flood the crystal with the gemstone's peculiar aether. Carefully, now!
Grab the components you require and assemble them on-site. We'll have that elevator running soon enough!

Even the beasts have a sweet scent about them!

We should get to a safe distance before they explode.
May priceless riches await!
And the story unfurls further!
Damn, he's gettin' fried!
Hah hah hah, I am untouchable!
Pip pip! Prrr!
The tunnel looks to have been maintained to some degree.
The path is certainly too smooth to be natural.
The cave itself is a natural formation, but this...
This cannot have been abandoned since the war.
It doesn't appear to be in use. And yet...
This is electrope...
That eye... Some sort of catoblepas, perhaps?
The only way out is through.

A fearsome opponent.
Onward!
We should be nearing the other end.

The city lives...
Something is amiss with that barrier...
The lightning is truly something to behold.
I, for one, would as soon hasten to shelter.
Stay low, and be wary if you hear a crackling.
They've been breached.
We secure this area first, then!
We've come in the midst of an emergency...
Now for the rest of the city...
We must hope we arrived in time.
That takes care of one...
Look there!
Treno's people are fighting!
We must aid them!
What must we do?
Above all else, remain calm.
Some have been wounded...
This looks to be a job for us.

If we are to fight it, this is the best place to do so.
Now I must look twice at every rock I see...
Our strength is not yet spent!
I sense the coming peril!
I shan't be caught off guard this time!
Let us settle this like gentlemen!
Violence is not the answer!
Gentle is as gentle does!
Surrender yourself into our custody!

Ware the vapors.
I assume there will be more to follow...

Aetherial combustion!?
So the lightning aether reacts to it... Interesting.
The lightning changes it!
The aether is responding...
A mutual reaction.
Be careful where you stand!
Mind the orbs!
A cyclone of levin? I would rather not.
Do you think it will react to the lightning aether?
I suspect this combination will be potent as well...
Keep one eye on the storm!
Are those...flowers?
It is...
Fill up on the stimulant and give the Euhedron a good spraying!
The scaffolding is ready and sturdy, so we need you to take care of the upper portion!
We've placed scaffolding so you can get up top. Lots of work to be done there!
I see. Just how much would we need for immeasurable profit...?
